### `ckhy`: contextual mixture/operation dispatch, global role open

There are 25 exact occurrences on 24 pages and 24 loci. Six are line-final and none is line-initial, so an operation such as `mischen/verrühren` is a useful contextual default in a closing process frame. Nineteen are medial, however. At `f32r.2`, `ckhy` follows an independent moist part and behaves as a content item; at `f10v.2`, it lies between a value sequence and a content/state series. Those positions are more naturally rendered `Mischung/Kompositum` than as an imperative.

The experiment therefore does not force one global R01 or R02 role. It dispatches reader wording by local geometry and keeps the global role open. It also does not assign R05: ordinary medial two-sided placement is the common F14 background and does not by itself establish a linker.

Status: exploratory continuation of the GDT761 lead deck; not a blinded
confirmatory test.

## Fixed targets and rivals

- `ckhy`: specific aqueous/wine medium; oil/oleaginous base; nominal
  preparation/compositum at a beginning stage; open relay/other.
- `pcheey`: specific medium; dry source/complement; post-moist result;
  record/Form-II field; opaque or bound-shell form.

  material/property head; opaque/other.

The eleven state pairs, three candidates, fourteen role hypotheses, exact
whole requirement, two distances, outer/discovery split, and zero component
export are fixed in the three source TSV decks. The two `sheo pcheey` cases are
known discovery observations. Any `sho pcheey` case belongs to the outer
control and is the only possible new replication within this run.

### Warum Recordfeld vor Stoffquelle steht

Alle drei Treffer liegen medial auf Absatzanfangszeilen, und jede dieser Zeilen
enthält mehrere H1-Recordformen:

- f10v.1: `paiin | pcheey`;
- f105r.24: `pcheor | paiin | pcheey`;
- f8r.9: `pcheey | pchey`.

Damit ist die sparsamste portable Bedeutung:

> `pcheey` = Trockenzubereitungs-/Form-II-Eintrag; Identität offen.

An genau den drei beobachteten Spans bleibt die konkretere Lesung
„Feuchtzubereitung mit/aus Trockengut, Form II“ als C1-Arbeitstheorie aktiv.
Ein zeitlicher Pfeil wäre zu viel: Die Folge kann eine Quellenrelation, eine
Feldfolge oder eine Listenstruktur ausdrücken. „Trockenmasse/Rückstand nach
Feuchtverarbeitung“ ist schwächer, weil ein Trenn-, Trocknungs-, Ergebnis- oder
Abschlusssignal fehlt.

Wasser, Wein und Öl sind für `pcheey` schlechte Kandidaten. Die Form hat keine
unabhängige Flüssigkeits-, Gefäß- oder Prozesssignatur. Die alte Hauptlesung
„Pulver“ wird entfernt: Sie stammte allein aus der unzulässigen Gleichung EVA
`p` = lateinisch *pulvis*. Logisch könnte die komplette Ganzform später wieder
als Pulver-Kandidat auftauchen, aber nur mit neuer unabhängiger Evidenz.

### `pcheey`: R04 preparation/form-II field, with zero dry evidence

There are only three exact occurrences, but all three immediately follow `sho` or `sheo`, and two form a `pcheey-X-daiin` construction. All three are medial in paragraph-opening lines. This repeated bounded-field geometry supports R04 and the neutral reader phrase `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld`.

The dry frame F03 has zero support. There is also no independent vessel, operation, passage/straining, or closing signal. A previous powder-like reading inherited from the shape of EVA `p` is therefore excluded from the default. Paste, salve, mixed form, or residue after soaking remain possible identities, but none is selected.

The C-levels are internal working-confidence labels, not probabilities. In particular, C1 or C2 at role level does not promote an English, German, Latin, or Middle English word identity above C0.

### `otar`: R05 step transition, not `bis`

Of 110 exact `otar` occurrences on 55 pages, 105 are medial. Four clean state bridges run in mixed directions rather than repeatedly pointing toward one endpoint. In `f86v5.13`, `otar` follows a complete amount expression and opens the next value field; in `f75r.43`, it sits between a state block and a repeated close/result form; in `f115v.5`, it directly precedes an independent process word. A general `dann/anschließend/weiter` survives all three uses better than a specific material or process term.

The local frames make `weiter/dann` a useful reader default, but R05 and R01 both pass with the same score of 1.0. R05 is selected only by specificity priority, so the nominal preparation/record field remains the principal supported role rival. Confidence is `C1_LOCAL_FRAME__C0_ROLE_TIEBREAK`. At identity level, `bis` is now the primary rival: mixed transition directions make it less portable than a general continuation marker, but do not eliminate it. No lexical identity is confirmed.

limits: Eight deliberately selected public historical assertions, not a random prevalence estimate or an exhaustive GDT740–779 audit.

Negation or insufficient support does not erase a genuinely proposed rival. Conversely this audit provides no rule restoring every previously archived denial.
